payload.summary: The whole decision in one document, and the densest thing in this archive. The report sets out the five proposed changes; records that the consultation ran and drew 72 responses; and, in paragraphs 17 to 22, takes each significant objection in turn and says what the council did about it. Paragraphs 23 to 28 record the Scrutiny committee's request to delete section 3.8.7.3 and the portfolio holder's refusal. Appendix A is the proposed 2026 policy, Appendix B the equality impact assessment, and Appendix C the consultation figures — the agree, disagree and neutral split for each of the five proposals.
